hero.caption: NATURAL SALINE OR SALT SPRING 	WHICH SUPPLIED EARLY SETTLERS WITH AN IMPORTANT MINERAL AND PRESERVATIVE. NATHAN & DANIEL M. BOONE, SONS OF DANIEL BOONE MANUFACTURED SALT HERE FROM 1806 TO 1811 WHEN THEY SOLD THEIR INTERESTS TO THE MORRISON BROTHERS WHO CONTINUED THE BUSINESS UNTIL 1833. 60 POUNDS OF SALT FROM 300 GALLONS OF BRINE
